messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT detected — multiple inference-worker OOMs in us-west-2 and node flaps. Alerts show paged-attn allocator fragmentation trending high. Link: https://console.redwood/inc/1745678901

maria: looking at allocator metrics — resident_pages steadily rising, free_slots dropping. KV page fragmentation has been creeping since ~03:00 UTC. Seems like slab coalescing isn't keeping up.

sanjay: confirmed. stack traces show repeated 'cudaDriverError' during allocation attempts, then kernel retries, then OOMs. Pods crash and kube restarts them. Affected pods: kv-allocator-v2-*.

kelly: @maria any quick numbers on customer impact? ops dashboard shows elevated 5xx for embedding routes.

maria: snapshot: 95th latency +300ms; 5xx rate for tenants A/B up 0.2% -> 1.7%. A couple of tenants flagged by customer-ops. I'll paste the tail logs.

maria: ```
[2025-06-18T03:12:05Z] kv-alloc ERROR: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory (driver alloc)
[2025-06-18T03:12:05Z] kv-alloc WARN: allocation retry 3 -> fallback attempt
[2025-06-18T03:12:07Z] kv-alloc ERROR: OOM, pid=1278, killing container
```

alex: I'm going to do an emergency config tweak + rolling restart of ds/kv-allocator on 3 affected nodes. Plan: lower eviction threshold and enable immediate slab compaction. Command: `kubectl -n inference set env daemonset/kv-allocator KV_EVICT_THRESHOLD=0.55 && kubectl rollout restart daemonset/kv-allocator`

deploy-bot: Started rollout on nodes i-0abc1234, i-0def5678, i-0f12abcd. ETA ~4m per node, will stagger. Will post updates.

sanjay: also bumping reserved capacity for hosted inference pool to avoid traffic queueing. @ops-bot can you route overflow to dedicated-west while we stabilize?

ops-bot: Reroute in progress — shifting ~12% of live traffic for embedding routes to dedicated-west. Config change applied, propagation ~30s.

maria: running on-node compaction on i-0abc1234: `/usr/local/bin/kv_compact --force --slab=3` — triggering background defrag.

kelly: customer-ops reports Tenant B sees degraded outputs on >2048 token requests. Recommend fallback to smaller model for long-context requests until allocator stabilized.

alex: applied route override for tenant B: /v1/generate -> rw-lite-1 (canary). Will monitor quality signals.

sanjay: fragmentation metric peaked ~0.87. After compaction + restarts it's down to ~0.62 on those nodes. OOM events stopped on restarted nodes.

maria: proposing to keep KV_EVICT_THRESHOLD at 0.55 and set a cron defrag every 15m for the next 6 hours. Also creating a hotfix ticket for allocator free-list coalescing regression.

kelly: drafted customer note and sent to account contacts for tenants A/B. ETA for full rollback of emergency changes: ~1h after monitoring stable.

deploy-bot: Rollout completed on the 3 targeted nodes. No further restarts pending.

maria: postmortem stub: likely regression in paged-attn allocator's free-list coalescing under bursty KV growth; leads to slow page fragmentation -> allocation failures on CUDA driver -> container OOM. Ticket INF-4421 created and assigned to eng-runtime.

sanjay: assigning INF-4421 to eng-runtime. Pinging @alex and @maria for triage.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated. Metrics stable for 8m; no new OOMs seen. Will keep this incident open for 30m of watch and then auto-close if stable. :white_check_mark:
